newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CEPA falls to intraday low ahead of close.
newsitem.headline: CEPA falls to intraday low ahead of close.

text.p: Shares of Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd (CEPA) fell on profit-taking in Wednesday afternoon trade, brokers said.
CEPA shares fell HK$0.65 or 4.05 percent to its intraday low of HK$15.40 ahead of close on volume of 10.79 million shares.
CEPA's share price had recently risen on speculation that its parent Hopewell Holdings Ltd might sell its CEPA stake at a premium to its trading price, brokers said.
"Speculation that a share sale agreement will soon be reached also triggered profit-taking interest," said a sales director at a regional brokerage.
The CEPA and Hopewell officials were not available for comment.
Hopewell said last month it was in talks to sell all or part of its 60.4 percent stake in CEPA on September 16.
Brokers said there was speculation Hopewell might sell its stake at a price ranging from of HK$18 to HK$21 per share.
Hopewell shares also edged up HK$0.025 to HK$4.55 per share in late trade.
